passage:
Every Tuesday evening, a group of adults came to the school library. They were not teachers or parents at a meeting. They were students.
Some wanted to learn English for travel. Some needed it for work. Others simply wanted to try something new.
The young students were surprised to see adults doing homework. One boy asked his mother, "Why do they study after working all day"
His mother answered, "Because learning does not end when school ends."
One evening, the adult class and the students met for a reading activity. The adults made mistakes, laughed, and tried again. The students saw that being brave in learning is not about age. It is about being willing to begin.
